name: Mighty Crown: Empire of Gold

features.name: Empire Bonus
features.description: Three Bonus symbols turn into wilds and start the bonus game.

features.name: Stacking multipliers
features.description: If wilds cover every position, each awards x1 to x5, for a total multiplier of up to x15.

features.name: Chance Level
features.description: A higher-bet option that raises the chance of triggering the bonus.

review:
Mighty Crown: Empire of Gold is a classic 3-reel slot with 5 paylines and an ancient-gold theme. It skips the hold-and-win formula that dominates Wazdan's catalogue in favour of one simple bonus.

Landing three Bonus symbols opens the Empire Bonus, where each Bonus symbol becomes a wild. If the wilds cover every position, each one awards a multiplier from x1 to x5, which can stack to a total win multiplier of up to x15. Chance Level raises the bet to make the bonus more likely. Wazdan publishes a 96.13% RTP, very high volatility and a 1,500x max win, so despite the simple layout, wins arrive in bursts. It suits players who like old-school reels with a single big feature.
pros: Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
